sentence_stem: Had the committee consulted the staff earlier,
correct_completion: the proposal would have been far more realistic.
full_sentence: Had the committee consulted the staff earlier, the proposal would have been far more realistic.
acceptable_variants: the proposal would be far more realistic today.
the project would have avoided many costly errors.

options.text: the proposal will be far more realistic.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' belongs to real future conditions. A hypothetical past condition needs 'would have' plus a past participle in the main clause.

options.text: the staff proposed a more realistic plan.
options.why_wrong: This is a simple past statement. It does not complete the conditional structure started by 'had'.

options.text: the proposal would have been far more realistic.
the committee would consult the staff now.
options.why_wrong: The stem refers to a past condition, so the result must also refer to the past. 'Would consult now' gives a present result.

grammar_focus: Inverted third conditional with 'had' and 'would have'
explanation: Inverted third conditionals drop 'if' and move 'had' to the front of the sentence. The main clause then needs 'would have' plus a past participle to express a hypothetical past result. Learners may reach for a simple conditional with 'would' alone, because they do not separate the perfect form in the same way.
translation: Se a comissão tivesse consultado a equipe antes, a proposta teria sido muito mais realista.
